description:
[Admin]

Proposes a few clearly different looks for one kind of page block, from the block's content and the brand's CSS variables. Each comes with a name, a one-line description and CSS that already passes the checks of portal-component-styles. Nothing is stored: show them, and save the one the person picks with save_component_style. Style settings are switched on per company by JobMojito; while they are off this endpoint answers 403. At most 30 requests an hour per person.

block.description: The block as it is in page content (its title, text, items, layout), so the looks fit what it holds.

block_type.description: The kind of block to design for.

brand_id.description: A sub-brand; leave it out for the main brand. Its CSS variables shape the looks.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

instruction.description: What the person wants, in their words.
instruction.example: Darker, with more space around the title

merchant_id.description: Optional company. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

name: Generate_component_style_alternatives

css.description: Ready for save_component_style: every selector on .jm-site and the style class.

name.description: A name no style of this block has yet.

title: Portal Component Styles Generate
